scope: Whole-vehicle reduced-order dual-FOC regenerative stop and early central dump timing comparison. This is a power/energy behavior model, not a switched circuit or vehicle qualification result.

engineering_assumptions_only.mass_source: Existing project comparison input; not independently confirmed by the user in this task.
engineering_assumptions_only.dual_foc_regeneration_split: equal power split between FOC-A and FOC-B
engineering_assumptions_only.brake_build_delay_note: Sensitivity points only; no actual FOC torque build time or torque ramp has been released.
engineering_assumptions_only.mppt_note: 30 W is only a bounded injection sensitivity because current topology/enable state is not available.

current_pb0_pb7_behavior_candidate.release_threshold_note: 38.35 V preserves the nominal 0.15 V hysteresis under a shared +0.25 V offset. Independent full-corner hysteresis and actual calibrated threshold are not guaranteed.
notes: The PB7 timing and R/L/FV values are inherited conditional screening inputs from current regulator design details, not guaranteed component limits.
PB0 static threshold is FAIL pending calibrated VREF/ADC behavior and correction of the current firmware conversion issue.

legacy_hard_tlv_candidate.model: ideal instantaneous hysteretic switch into the nominal resistor; comparator, driver, switch, wiring and inductance delays excluded

ltc2965_candidate.range_status: Independent initial-corner screen; not a guaranteed installed threshold.
ltc2965_candidate.response_bound_note: The cited 80 us datasheet maximum applies to a specified 10x range and overdrive condition, not this candidate's 40x range and low overdrive.

independent_hard_early_candidate.candidate_type: TLV1811 + REF5025 independent push-pull threshold screen, 143.6 kOhm upper divider

comparison_proxy.note: Reuse of existing hot PB0/PB7 loop screening point only; not evidence for the new candidate.

power_path_states.name: dual_refusal_lpv_core_alive
power_path_states.expected_path: PB0 local BUS threshold to PB7 PWM, with existing TLV hard backup

power_path_states.name: bms_disconnect_or_lpv_core_revoked_central_12v_alive
power_path_states.expected_path: Only existing 40.32 V TLV hardware fallback is credited; the PB0/PB7 software path is disabled by the LPV/CORE hard gate.

power_path_states.name: central_12v_lost
power_path_states.expected_path: No central active dump is credited; FOC local BOV/Break may stop PWM, but post-Break mechanical braking and body-diode energy are unresolved.
